exposure: Patwardhan technique for delivery of deeply engaged fetal head during C-section
push or pull technique for delivery of deeply engaged fetal head during C-section
cohort: The study included 480 women (240 in each group) undergoing emergency C-section for deeply engaged fetal head, with a majority aged 20-30 years.
finding: The Patwardhan's technique significantly reduced the incidence of uterine incision extension (22.50% vs 40.83%, p < 0.05) compared to the push or pull method when delivering a profoundly impacted fetal head during second-stage C-section, with a trend towards lower NICU admission.
mod_finding: The Patwardhan's technique for C-section delivery of deeply engaged fetal heads was associated with a significantly lower rate of uterine incision extension compared to the push or pull method.
